project: Biomethane plant digital twin + ML surrogate + TEA
description: ADM1 co-digestion model (Python) coupled to a DWSIM biogas-upgrading flowsheet with biogenic-CO2 recovery; ML surrogate trained on simulated data for fast feed-blend/HRT optimisation; techno-economics (LCOE, NPV) benchmarked to literature.
rationale: Hits the biggest job pool for the profile (biomethane: FR/DE/ES/CA policy targets); combines mass/energy balances, simulator, Python automation, ML and TEA in one story. Feasibility 4 (not 5): ADM1 stiffness and DWSIM-pythonnet coupling are real risks.

project: Fed-batch fermentation soft sensor & fault detection (IndPenSim)
description: ML soft sensors (PLS on Raman, XGBoost/MLP on process data) and batch fault detection on the public 100-batch, 100 m3 IndPenSim penicillin dataset.
rationale: Real public industrial-scale dataset, strong digital-biomanufacturing signal. Novelty 3: the dataset is already widely used for soft-sensor studies; no process design / balances / TEA, so it under-uses DWSIM and process-engineering skills.

description: Open-source process model and cost of goods for a recombinant food protein; titre-rate-yield sensitivity and scale-up economics.
rationale: Very topical (EU Biotech Act, capacity gap) but strain/process data are mostly proprietary, so results rest on literature assumptions; weaker link to biogas background.

project: Biogenic CO2 from upgrading to e-methane / liquid CO2 (TEA)
description: Capture, liquefaction or methanation of the upgrading off-gas with green H2.
rationale: Rising topic (biogenic CO2 capture growing fast in EU) but H2 cost assumptions dominate; best included as a scenario inside P01.

project: Fed-batch feeding optimisation with Bayesian optimisation
description: Mechanistic E. coli / yeast fed-batch model; BO + DoE to maximise productivity.
rationale: Good modelling showcase, but kinetic parameters come from literature only and the story is less tied to a concrete industrial asset.

description: Water scrubbing vs amine vs membranes vs PSA: energy use, methane slip, cost.
rationale: Directly useful for biomethane jobs, but well-trodden topic; becomes a sub-module of P01.

description: MILP scheduling of gas storage + CHP against public day-ahead prices.
rationale: Policy-driven (German Biomassepaket) but closer to energy-trading optimisation than bioprocess.

project: Wastewater plant energy optimisation on BSM2 + ML
description: Benchmark Simulation Model no. 2 with ML-based aeration/digester control.
rationale: Well documented benchmark; job market is water utilities rather than bioprocess.

description: BioSTEAM model of pretreatment, fermentation, purification; MSP and LCA.
rationale: Classic academic TEA; fewer matching job postings for a junior profile.

description: DWSIM flowsheet + pinch analysis and heat-exchanger network.
rationale: Solid engineering exercise but mature topic with low 2026 market pull.

description: Photobioreactor cultivation, harvesting, product split and economics.
rationale: Interesting but commercially marginal; few junior postings.

project: Regional biomethane feedstock potential & plant siting (France)
description: GIS of agricultural/agri-food residues and optimal plant siting.
rationale: Data assembly heavy (heterogeneous public datasets), mostly GIS rather than process engineering.
